comments:
Sho sgom (ID:3857), Dus gsum mkhyen pa (ID:3855) and Phag mo gru pa (ID:3856) are known as the "grub thob mi gsum" and as the "khams pa mi gsum."
[EZ5JXHJY]: 356 and n. 16 takes him to be the same person as Tshul khrims snying po (ID:6157) and gives the dates 1116-1169.
It is assumed here to be the same person as "gsal ston sho sgom," studen of sGam po pa (ID:4189).
alternative_names:
gsal ston sho sgom
shwo sgom
name: gsal sto sho sgom
